verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so in-browser editing and committing is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents browsing files, comparing diffs and leaving feedback in the browser. Code changes are shown arriving through Git clients, the CLI, or handing work to external coding agents, which are adjacent paths rather than a browser editor that commits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can respond to review feedback by editing and committing code directly in the browser
